maddeler.e: بَرْغَز or بُرْغُز • (barḡaz or burḡuz) m (plural بَرَاغِز (barāḡiz), feminine بَرْغَزَة (barḡaza) or بُرْغُزَة (burḡuza))
maddeler.t: Borrowed from Aramaic בַר עִזָּא / ܒܪ ܥܙܐ (bar ʿezzā, “goat-son”). Compare بَرْغَش (barḡaš, “gnat”), بُرْعُم (burʕum, “scion”), بَزْر (bazr, “seed”).
g: the young of a cow, calf or heifer
